verification.humanVerification: Cloudflare Turnstile managed widget on production domain; server validates success, hostname, action. Missing and invalid tokens return 403 in production; widget success visually verified.
verification.sessionRestoration: 30-day existing HttpOnly session reused by login page and homepage; bfcache, cross-tab changes and service-error retry covered by frontend regression tests.
verification.productionAPI: registration, HttpOnly/Secure cookies, isolation, upsert/pull, idempotency, conflicts, image SHA-256, image deduplication, delete/restore/history, CSRF, logout revocation
verification.browserUI: localhost connected to a real isolated Go deployment: register, create, image upload, save, reload, edit, history, soft delete/restore, responsive reading
verification.productionBrowserLimitation: Login/register DOM verified. Subsequent automated form input timed out; not counted as a completed production browser signup.

knownBoundaries.desktopClientSync: implemented in local v1.4.11 development build, not yet a public Release. Native email/password login has no CAPTCHA; registration opens website in system browser. Todos and screenshot history remain local.
knownBoundaries.email: SMTP not configured; verification and password-reset email logic tested with a fake mail transport only
knownBoundaries.backups: provider database backup policy and independent backup/restore drill not established by this change
knownBoundaries.retention: 30-day restore rule; no physical purging job in this release
knownBoundaries.git: no commit or push in this deployment task; existing desktop working changes preserved
